generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A ready result-only handoff is reused after the remote branch advances through one or more material commits, leaving its evidence bound to an ancestral material candidate.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Trust a stored ready certificate or the identity of the writer instead of re-reading remote head, parent and changed paths before deciding whether result-only reuse is safe.
trigger_signals: remote head differs from published handoff
current parent is not the certified material head
a material path appears after handoff
generalized_learning.reusable_control: HANDOFF-DRIFT: re-read remote lineage and classify recovery solely from certified material identity, parent and changed paths before terminal publication.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: After any remote-head drift, require writer-agnostic identity reclassification and a new material freeze whenever the certified material identity is no longer the candidate.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Audit preflight must distinguish stable-material result-only publication from stale handoff drift and require refreeze whenever lineage or material paths diverge.

transfer_cases.procedure: Apply the classifier to a ready handoff followed by an external material commit.
transfer_cases.observed: The recovery scope is post-write-refreeze rather than handoff-only.

transfer_cases.procedure: Apply the terminal latch to a ready handoff followed by a CI-remediation material commit.
transfer_cases.observed: Terminal readiness remains blocked until a new material freeze and result-only child exist.

skill_changes.evidence: Existing writer-agnostic recovery classification and terminal result-only publication rules were executed again for this rejection.
Existing CI remediation handoff latch remains the transferable prevention control for material writes after handoff.
